title: docs(policy): FPL-true wood-species template example + provenance test (C-13 follow-up)
intent: Correct the false provenance claim left on main by #486: the wood-species update template attributed example shrinkage 5.0/3.1 to FPL_GTR282_table_4-3, which has no such row. Replace the example with the FPL sugar maple record (matching CLAUDE.md, density 706) and add a CI test so policy examples cannot drift from their cited FPL tables.
behavior_change: none - documentation, one test file, and one added Core CI step that runs it. No application code, data file, route or schema changes.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Template example: shrinkage 9.9/4.8 (Table 4-3 p.4-8), density 706, SG 0.63, MOE 12.6, MOR 109.0, Janka 6,400 N / 1,439 lbf (Table 5-3a), each with a source field; new scripts/ci/test_policy_fpl_examples.py wired into core_ci.yml; VERIFICATION_LOG C-13 follow-up note.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: #486's C-13 relabelled the template's shrinkage to FPL Table 4-3 without changing the values, which are not in that table; no existing check reads the policy examples.

commands_run: same test against main's template (f162971e) -> fails: 'contraction_tangential_pct: 5.0 vs FPL Table 4-3 9.9', radial 3.1 vs 4.8, and Janka/SG with no source field
CLAUDE.md example (sugar maple, 706 / 9.9 / 4.8) unchanged and passes
neither example shows volumetric shrinkage; nothing derived to recompute
